descriptions.apply_ir_apply_bindinputs: Reads the four manifest-r6 package files from the B-136 IR artifact folder, refuses unless each file's SHA-256 equals the manifest value, and refuses unless every one of the ten A1–A10 old/new pairs occurs literally in IR packet r2; returns the file texts.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_bindinputs: Reads the four manifest-r6 package files from the B-136 IR artifact folder, refuses unless each file's SHA-256 equals the manifest value, and refuses unless every one of the ten A1–A10 old/new pairs occurs literally in IR packet r2; returns the file texts.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_fail: Prints a REFUSE message to standard error and exits the process with code 2.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_fail: Prints a REFUSE message to standard error and exits the process with code 2.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_note: Prints a progress line and appends it to the in-memory run log written at the end of the run.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_note: Prints a progress line and appends it to the in-memory run log written at the end of the run.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_rd: Reads a repository-relative file as raw bytes from the target checkout.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_rd: Reads a repository-relative file as raw bytes from the target checkout.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_expectedapply: Builds the expected text of each of the five target files from its current bytes: applies A1–A10 in order, refuses unless each old text occurs exactly once in the then-current buffer, and substitutes D-NNN and 2026-10-NN only inside the replacement text.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_expectedapply: Builds the expected text of each of the five target files from its current bytes: applies A1–A10 in order, refuses unless each old text occurs exactly once in the then-current buffer, and substitutes D-NNN and 2026-10-NN only inside the replacement text.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_blobof: Returns the Git blob id of a byte buffer by piping it to git hash-object --no-filters --stdin.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_blobof: Returns the Git blob id of a byte buffer by piping it to git hash-object --no-filters --stdin.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_composebody: Composes the D-438 Register entry from the bound body and the Route B addendum: inserts the addendum's item-0 block with its quote prefixes removed, fills every slot from the fixed slot table, and refuses if any slot token remains.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_composebody: Composes the D-438 Register entry from the bound body and the Route B addendum: inserts the addendum's item-0 block with its quote prefixes removed, fills every slot from the fixed slot table, and refuses if any slot token remains.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_count: Counts the occurrences of a substring in a string.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_count: Counts the occurrences of a substring in a string.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_git: Runs a git command against the target checkout and returns its trimmed standard output.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_git: Runs a git command against the target checkout and returns its trimmed standard output.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_log: The list of progress lines written to the mode's log file at the end of the run.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_log: The list of progress lines written to the mode's log file at the end of the run.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_sha: Returns the hex SHA-256 of a byte buffer.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_sha: Returns the hex SHA-256 of a byte buffer.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_a: The ten A1–A10 replacement pairs (target path, exact old text, new text with D-NNN and 2026-10-NN placeholders), transcribed from IR packet r2.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_a: The ten A1–A10 replacement pairs (target path, exact old text, new text with D-NNN and 2026-10-NN placeholders), transcribed from IR packet r2.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_bound: The seven governed files bound for the unit with their expected Git blob ids at 5d00503: the five IR targets, the Register and the Build Spec.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_bound: The seven governed files bound for the unit with their expected Git blob ids at 5d00503: the five IR targets, the Register and the Build Spec.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_files: The verified package texts returned by bindInputs at start-up.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_files: The verified package texts returned by bindInputs at start-up.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_five: The five IR target paths: the first five entries of the bound-file table.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_five: The five IR target paths: the first five entries of the bound-file table.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_manifest: The four package files the run binds, with their manifest-r6 SHA-256 values.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_manifest: The four package files the run binds, with their manifest-r6 SHA-256 values.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_slots: The fixed slot values used to compose the D-438 body: section 5.14e262, date 2026-10-15, the Judge's verbatim quotes, the act file path and SHA-256, and the setup clause.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_slots: The fixed slot values used to compose the D-438 body: section 5.14e262, date 2026-10-15, the Judge's verbatim quotes, the act file path and SHA-256, and the setup clause.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply: D-438 applying helper, revision 1 (the revision that ran S0–S2). Modes: s0 runs the pre-write checks and composes the Register body; act appends the body to the Register; verify-act and verify-apply compare a commit's paths and blobs with the expected values; apply writes the ten replacements with per-write checks and an inverse check. Refuses with exit 2 on any mismatch.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_s0: Pre-write stage S0: refuses unless the seven bound files have their expected blobs, each A1–A10 old text occurs exactly once and only in its target across governed docs outside the handoff, fragment and Register paths, D-438 is absent from the Register, every file that mentions D-438 is on a fixed allowed-path list, and the bound paths have no working-tree changes. The D-438 check is by file path only.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2: D-438 applying helper, revision 2. Same modes and checks as revision 1, plus: the target checkout and output folder can be overridden for disposable-copy controls, the D-438 check inspects each mentioning line, and a controls-only setting appends one byte after the first write.
descriptions.apply_ir_apply_r2_s0: Pre-write stage S0 as in revision 1, except the D-438 check: a mention is accepted when it is in the IR artifact folder, or in B-136 under a level-2 section heading that names IR or D-438; any other mention refuses. This is a section-heading check, not a check of what each commitment says.
